title: 12 Best Hawker Centres in Singapore
description: Discover Singapore's top 12 hawker centres for authentic, affordable local cuisine. From iconic Maxwell to bustling Old Airport Road, find your next culinary adventure.

places.name: Maxwell Food Centre
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Tian Tian Hainanese Chicken Rice (Stall 10 & 11) is legendary, but also try the Fuzhou Oyster Cake from Maxwell Fuzhou Oyster Cake (Stall 5).

places.name: Old Airport Road Food Centre
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Mattar Road BBQ Seafood for their famous Sambal Stingray, and Roxy Laksa for a creamy, spicy bowl. Don't miss the Char Kway Teow from Lao Fu Zi Fried Kway Teow.

places.name: Tiong Bahru Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Tiong Bahru Lor Mee for rich, savory noodles, and Jian Bo Shui Kueh for their iconic Chwee Kueh (steamed rice cakes with preserved radish).

places.name: Lau Pa Sat
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Satay from any of the stalls on Boon Tat Street (especially for dinner). Also try the Hokkien Mee or Chilli Crab from various vendors inside.

places.name: Amoy Street Food Centre
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A Noodle Story for their Michelin-starred Singapore-style ramen, or Li Xin Teochew Fishball Noodles for classic bouncy fishballs.

places.name: Tekka Centre
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Allauddin's Briyani or Sakunthala's Food Palace for excellent biryani, and the various stalls offering crispy Roti Prata with curry.

places.name: Hong Lim Market & Food Centre
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Famous 50-year-old Heng Kee Curry Chicken Noodles and Tai Hwa Pork Noodle (note: not the Michelin-starred branch, but excellent).

places.name: Newton Food Centre
places.priceRange: S$15-40+ / $11-$30+ USD per person (especially for seafood)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Chili Crab or Black Pepper Crab, BBQ Stingray, and Satay. Be sure to confirm prices before ordering seafood by weight.

places.name: Chomp Chomp Food Centre
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Sambal Stingray, BBQ Chicken Wings, Hokkien Mee, and a refreshing Sugarcane Juice.

places.name: Adam Road Food Centre
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Selera Rasa Nasi Lemak (a favorite of the Sultan of Brunei!) and Indian Rojak from Adam Road Indian Rojak.

places.name: Ghim Moh Market & Food Centre
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Chuan Kee Kway Chap for tender braised pig offal with flat rice noodles, and Ghim Moh Carrot Cake for a delicious fried radish cake.

places.name: Golden Mile Food Centre
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Thai Boat Noodles from one of the many stalls, or traditional Singaporean dishes like Hainanese Curry Rice.
